dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Kamu punya beberapa menit? Aku ingin meminta masukan tentang presentasiku.
dialogue.en: Do you have a few minutes? I would like some feedback on my presentation.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tentu. Pertama-tama, strukturnya jelas dan contoh-contohmu menarik.
dialogue.en: Of course. First of all, the structure was clear and your examples were interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Terima kasih. Lalu, apa yang bisa kuperbaiki?
dialogue.en: Thank you. And what could I improve?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Aku punya saran: coba bicara lebih lambat, terutama di awal.
dialogue.en: I have a suggestion: try to speak more slowly, especially at the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Aku memang gugup. Apakah itu terlihat jelas?
dialogue.en: I did feel nervous. Was it really noticeable?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sedikit, tetapi mudah diperbaiki. Jeda singkat di antara poin utama akan membantu.
dialogue.en: A little, but it is easy to fix. A short pause between the main points would help.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Ada lagi? Tolong jujur. Aku bisa menerima kritik.
dialogue.en: Anything else? Please be honest. I can take criticism.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Slide terakhir memuat terlalu banyak teks, jadi hadirin mulai membaca alih-alih mendengarkan.
dialogue.en: The final slides had too much text, so the audience started reading instead of listening.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Itu membantu. Bisakah kamu lebih spesifik, slide yang mana?
dialogue.en: That is helpful. Could you be more specific about which slides?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Slide delapan dan sembilan. Pakai satu gambar dan satu kalimat saja.
dialogue.en: Slides eight and nine. Use one image and one sentence instead.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Akan kulakukan. Jujur, aku takut presentasiku berjalan buruk.
dialogue.en: I will do that. Honestly, I was afraid it had gone badly.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sama sekali tidak. Kamu sudah membuat kemajuan nyata sejak presentasi terakhirmu.
dialogue.en: Not at all. You have made real progress since your last presentation.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Itu sangat memotivasi aku untuk terus berlatih.
dialogue.en: That really motivates me to keep practicing.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Bagus. Masukan yang membangun seharusnya memotivasi orang, bukan menyurutkan semangat mereka.
dialogue.en: Good. Constructive feedback should motivate people, not discourage them.

dialogue.speaker: Andi
dialogue.text: Setuju. Maukah kamu kalau minggu depan aku memberimu masukan tentang presentasimu?
dialogue.en: Agreed. Would you like me to give you feedback on yours next week?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Aku akan berterima kasih. Terima kasih sudah terbuka soal ini.
dialogue.en: I would be grateful. Thank you for being open to it.
